error_article-provider: Web provider unavailable. Check the native web configuration

error_article-not-found: Article not found or removed. Check its URL

error_article-truncated: Article text is incomplete or too long. Supply complete text

error_fetch-batch-limit: Selection exceeds the current result budget. Fetch smaller batches

error_task-unavailable: Task ended or must be stopped in its conversation
error_storage-size: Local records exceed the storage limit
noMatches: No matching articles. Try another keyword.
